decision: Owner decision, 6 Oct 2026: Kiyo is reading-first. Lines whose Sayo take could not be verified by the automatic speech screen ship WITHOUT a Sayo clip (the app falls back to the device voice) instead of blocking the release. They are not marked reviewed. Remove a line from this list as soon as an accepted take is installed.
reason: Erhua (儿化) endings: automatic transcription (local ASR and Whisper large-v3) consistently omits 儿, so the screen cannot confirm the rhotic ending. Native listening still needed.
